component.name: jellyfin
component.description: TAPPaaS module jellyfin: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). Jellyfin 10.11.11 runs on its NixOS VM (port 8096), published through the firewall's Caddy to home, netbird and internet zones behind Authentik forward-auth (group users, #805), so no request reaches it before an Authentik login; the library is an NFS share mounted at /media. Live check: the server launches nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 (--ffmpeg flag), which the scan matches as ffmpeg 7.1.4; ffmpeg 8.1.2 (via opencv/frei0r) and ffmpeg-headless 8.1.2 (via chromaprint, pipewire) are in the closure too, and the only 8.1.2 library anything loads is ffmpeg-headless's libavutil.so.60, through chromaprint. Each ffmpeg CVE is triaged against the fork's own source (n7.1.4 plus its debian/patches): library files are attacker-relevant input to it, so decoder/demuxer CVEs it still contains are kept affected. Hardware acceleration is none and the VM has only a QEMU VGA (no render node, no NVIDIA). GStreamer, libtiff, libxslt and cups come in via gtk4/zenity (SDL), opencv and pipewire chains that neither the jellyfin process nor ffmpeg maps; gst-plugins-good/-ugly are absent. Filter names floodfill/swaprect/hqdn3d/quirc/frei0r and the spdif format do not occur in Jellyfin's encoding assemblies.

analysis.detail: GitHub Actions workflow in the jellyfin-ios repository; not part of the Jellyfin server package.
Ubuntu's CUPS AppArmor profile; NixOS ships no such profile and only cups-lib is present (via gtk), no cupsd.

VobSub .idx/.sub heap overflow (libavformat/mpeg.c), present in jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3; Jellyfin picks up external .idx/.sub next to videos and hands them to its ffmpeg. Risk here: medium: needs a crafted file in the library (NFS share writers, media fetched from untrusted sources); Jellyfin is reachable only after an Authentik login (forward-auth, #805), and the parse runs in a transient ffmpeg as the hardened jellyfin user. Action: fixed upstream in dbd495f; needs a jellyfin-ffmpeg release carrying it, so check the nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg bump.

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

analysis.detail: NVDEC double free needs an NVIDIA GPU with NVDEC hwaccel; the VM has no NVIDIA device and Jellyfin's HardwareAccelerationType is none (the code is in jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3).
S/PDIF muxer (code present in jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3); Jellyfin never selects the spdif output format (absent from its encoding code).

RTP/ASF depacketizer loop, present in jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3; reachable only through a network stream URL (library .strm or a Live TV source), not local media files. Risk here: low: infinite-loop DoS of one ffmpeg process; needs a .strm in the library pointing at an attacker RTSP/RTP source, no Live TV tuner is configured. Action: fixed upstream in 11d5f47; needs a jellyfin-ffmpeg release carrying it, so check the nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg bump.

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

Risk here: medium: needs a crafted file in the library (NFS share writers, media fetched from untrusted sources); Jellyfin is reachable only after an Authentik login (forward-auth, #805), and the parse runs in a transient ffmpeg as the hardened jellyfin user. Action: fixed upstream in 1836ef9; needs a jellyfin-ffmpeg release carrying it, so check the nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg bump.

analysis.detail: eXIf writing in the PNG/APNG encoder is 8.x code: jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3's libavcodec/pngenc.c has no EXIF handling at all, so the overrun fixed by b506faf cannot occur.
vf_quirc (QR) filter (built into jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3); Jellyfin never builds a filtergraph containing it (absent from its encoding code) and users cannot inject filters.

Risk here: medium: needs a crafted file in the library (NFS share writers, media fetched from untrusted sources); Jellyfin is reachable only after an Authentik login (forward-auth, #805), and the parse runs in a transient ffmpeg as the hardened jellyfin user. analysis.detail: CENC subsample integer overflow in libavformat/mov.c: jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 carries the fix (n7.1.4 "avformat/mov: use 64bit in CENC subsample bounds checks"; all four scheme decrypt checks use int64_t).
EXR DWA width/height not divisible by 8: fixed in n7.1.2 (97932677, "avcodec/exr: Dont access outside xsize/ysize"), which jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 contains.
EXR DWA mixed channel pixel types: fixed in n7.1.2 (a9ec8317, "avcodec/exr: Check for pixel type consistency in DWA"); the check is in jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3's exr.c.

SANM use-after-free through STOR/FTCH re-decoding of a stored FOBJ (fixed by d311382/c41a70b in 8.0): jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3's sanm.c has no STOR/FTCH handling, so the reallocated stored frame is never re-parsed.
MagicYUV out-of-bounds write: jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 backports the upstream fix (PR 23159) as debian/patches/0094-backport-a-fix-from-upstream-for-magicyuv-decoder.patch.

read_global_param() is in the native av1 decoder, which only wraps hardware decoding: jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 registers it after libdav1d ("hwaccel hooks only, so prefer external decoders"), so software AV1 goes through libdav1d, and Jellyfin's HardwareAccelerationType is none.
tools/zmqsend.c is a developer tool that is not built: jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 ships only ffmpeg, ffprobe, ffplay and qt-faststart.
The av_bprint_finalize() overflow is reported against tools/zmqsend.c, a developer tool that is not built: jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 ships only ffmpeg, ffprobe, ffplay and qt-faststart.

Use-after-free on channel data after close; libssh is loaded by jellyfin-ffmpeg as its SFTP client and is reachable only via an sftp:// stream URL. Risk here: low: needs a library .strm with an sftp:// URL to an attacker SSH server; outcome is a crash or UAF in one ffmpeg process.. Action: Fixed in a newer libssh; next nixpkgs pin that carries it.

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

analysis.detail: Server-side GSSAPI key-exchange check; libssh is used only as libavformat's SFTP client, and the VM's sshd is OpenSSH.
TIFFReadRGBATile crash; libtiff is only linked by openjpeg/libwebp command-line tools, gdk-pixbuf/gtk4 and opencv, none of which Jellyfin or its ffmpeg load (ffmpeg decodes TIFF natively).
putcontig8bitYCbCr44tile overflow; libtiff is only linked by openjpeg/libwebp tools, gdk-pixbuf/gtk4 and opencv, none of which Jellyfin or its ffmpeg load.
libxslt is only in the closure via gst-plugins-bad -> lrdf -> raptor2 (gtk4/zenity chain); nothing running on the VM loads it.
Samba on HP NonStop servers (H06/J06); not this Linux samba build, which is present only as libsmbclient for ffmpeg.
